{{External|rs}} {{otheruses|the island|the dungeon|Waterbirth Island Dungeon}} {{Infobox Location |name = Waterbirth Island |image = [[File:Waterbirth Island.png|300px]] |release = [[1 August]] [[2005]] |update = Waterbirth Island |members = Yes |location = [[Fremennik Province]], [[Northern Ocean]] |race = [[Fremennik]] [[human]]s |teleport = * [[Waterbirth Teleport]] * [[Tele Group Waterbirth]] * [[Jarvald]] |music = [[The Desolate Isle]] |map = {{Map|name=Waterbirth Island|x=2525|y=3743|zoom=2}} |type = island |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} {{Relativelocation |location = Waterbirth Island |north = Miscellania |west = Jatizso |south = Lighthouse |east = Rellekka }} '''Waterbirth Island''' is a snowy, crescent-shaped island found in the [[Northern Ocean]], off the coast of [[Rellekka]]. The island is primarily known for the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon]], a multi-level dungeon that is home to a variety of dangerous monsters, including the powerful [[Dagannoth Kings]]. [[Bardur]] is located in this dungeon, constantly fighting a group of [[Dagannoth fledgeling|dagannoth fledgelings]]. The surface of the island contains several [[Rock Crab]]s and [[hobgoblin]]s, as well as an abundance of [[snape grass]]. [[Jarvald]] and [[Askeladden]] can also be found here. While on the surface of the island, snowflakes will appear to fall on the player's screen as a visual effect. ==History== The island plays an important role in Fremennik mythology, featuring as the main subject of stories like "the tale of the broken sky" and "the day of the green seas".{{CiteNPC|npc=Jarvald|quote=It is a small crescent-shaped island just north-west of here, outerlander. We have many legends about it, such as the tale of the broken sky, and the day of the green seas.}} In recent times, the island had been free of the dagannoth that currently infest its caves, as Fremennik warriors had driven them back into the sea at an unspecified point in the past.{{CiteNPC|npc=Jarvald|quote=Aye, the dagger-mouths! The vile creatures lived near here once, but we had thought them all driven back to the ocean depths many moons past.}} A short while ago however, the creatures once again landed on its shores, likely after being hatched somewhere under the sea by a dagannoth queen.{{CiteNPC|npc=Jarvald|quote=I can only imagine a dagger-mouth queen has nested somewhere nearby, and spawned her foul brood under the sea once more, and some of them have migrated to fair Waterbirth Island.}} This development seems to be embraced by at least some of the Fremennik, for whom the battle against the dagannoth holds a place of cultural significance.{{CiteNPC|npc=Jarvald|quote=We are glad the dagger-mouths have returned to these shores, for it means we will get the chance to hunt them once again as our ancestors did!}} ==Transportation== Players can get to the island via one of the following methods: * Speak to [[Jarvald]] at the Rellekka docks to travel to the island via boat (the player does not have to start or complete [[The Fremennik Trials]]; costs 1,000 [[coins]] each time if the quest is not complete) * Use a [[Waterbirth teleport (tablet)|Waterbirth teleport tablet]] * Use an [[enchanted lyre]] (with completion of the hard tier of the [[Fremennik Diary]]) * Cast [[Waterbirth Teleport]] (requires access to the [[Lunar spellbook]] and level 72 [[Magic]]) * Cast or be in range of another player casting [[Tele Group Waterbirth]] (casting requires access to the Lunar spellbook and level 73 Magic) * Teleport via a [[portal chamber]] or [[portal nexus]] in a [[player-owned house]] (requires the house owner to set up the portal first). * Through a [[mooring point]] with 74 [[Sailing]]. == Outdoor features == [[File:Waterbirth mountain.png|thumb|Askeladden atop the central mountain.]] Snape grass can be found all along the coast of the island; in particular, there are six [[Spawning|spawn points]] located near Jarvald and his boat. Rock Crabs can be found scattered across the island, in their disguised rock form. Hobgoblins can also be found roaming about the island, particularly on the western side. The main entrance to the Waterbirth Island Dungeon is found on the western side of the island, in the middle of the "crescent" shape formed by the island. There is also a secondary entrance, accessible at level 85 [[Agility]], by climbing the [[Rocks (Waterbirth Island)|rocks]] on the north-eastern side of the island (just south of [[Jarvald]]). This shortcut allows players to bypass the obstacles on the first floor of the dungeon, eliminating the need for solo players to bring a [[pet rock]] and [[Rune thrownaxe|rune thrownaxes]]. ==The dungeon== {{Main|Waterbirth Island Dungeon}} The Waterbirth Island Dungeon is a large, multi-level dungeon with branching paths. It is home to a variety of monsters including [[dagannoth]], [[Wallasalki|wallasalkis]], [[Giant Rock Crab|Giant Rock Crabs]], and [[Rock lobster|rock lobsters]]. The monsters in the dungeon can be dangerous, and the first floor contains obstacles that can be impossible to navigate for unprepared players. For this reason, players are recommended to read the main article before venturing to the dungeon. The monsters in the dungeon drop materials required to create [[Fremennik armour]]. [[Bardur]] can be found along a path about halfway through the dungeon, fighting a group of [[Dagannoth fledgeling|dagannoth fledgelings]]. The bottom floor of the dungeon is the lair of the [[Dagannoth Kings]], a trio of powerful boss monsters that each attack with a different [[combat style]]. Players often fight the Kings for their unique drops, including the [[Fremennik rings]]. [[Spinolyp|Spinolyps]] can also be found here. ===Sublevel 1 - Fremennik armour=== [[File:Waterbirth Dungeon (1).png|thumb|250px|The main room of the dungeon.]] After arriving on the island, go west and then south to the dungeon entrance. As soon as you enter the dungeon, you will be in a massive cavern filled with level 90 [[Dagannoth (Waterbirth Island)|dagannoth]]. They use [[melee]] attacks and are very dangerous (they will hit you consistently for damage without the [[Protect from Melee]] [[prayer]]). They sometimes drop [[dagannoth hide]]s used to make [[Fremennik armour]]. ====The three paths==== To continue you must have a companion, or a [[pet rock]]. Run east to the back of the cavern to one of three large, circular doors. Have one person stand on each of the two floor plates and open the door, or '''drop''' your pet rock on one floor plate and stand on the other yourself (you can pick your pet rock up before going through). Depending on which door you choose, you will find the following monsters with one of three [[Combat Options|attack styles]]: *North Path - [[Melee]] [[Dagannoth (Waterbirth Island)|dagannoth]] and [[Giant Rock Crab]]s *Middle Path - [[Magic]]-using [[Wallasalki]]s *South Path - [[Ranged|Ranging]] dagannoth When killed, the Giant Rock Crabs, wallasalkis, and ranging dagannoth can each drop components used to create [[Fremennik armour]]. Each creature drops a component for the amour set of its attack style (e.g. wallasalkis drop the components of [[skeletal armour]]). ===Sublevel 2 to 5 - Path to [[Dagannoth Kings]]=== [[File:Waterbirth Dungeon (2).png|thumb|250px|Sublevels 2-4 of the dungeon.]] [[File:Waterbirth Dungeon (3).png|thumb|250px|Sublevel 5 of the dungeon.]] Each of the three paths leads further east to a central room blocked with a door held up by props. The props can be knocked down with either [[Magic]] or [[Ranged]], but cannot be attacked from the front. The barricade for your path must be knocked down by another player who took a different path, or who entered the ladder room via the Agility shortcut. Solo adventurers can also use a [[rune thrownaxe]] [[special attack]] to knock down all three barricades at once. After passing your barricade, two eggs will immediately hatch [[Dagannoth spawn|baby dagannoth]] who will attack with [[Melee]]. Monsters from the other rooms may also enter through the knocked-down barricades to attack with Melee, Ranged or Magic. You can climb up the ladder in this room to reach the snow-covered mountain on the island, a safe area where [[Askeladden]] can be found. Climbing down the ladder leads to sublevel 2 of the dungeon. The ladder leading to the Dagannoth Kings' lair is found on sublevel 5. See the maps to the right for help navigating sublevels 2-5. ===East Sublevel 5 - Lighthouse exit=== On sublevel 5, past the ladder leading to the Dagannoth Kings, the player may take an alternative exit going east up to the [[Lighthouse]]. The exit is located in the last room of rock lobsters, furthest east. It is one-way out only.
